verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a REST API for managing syncs, models, sources, and destinations, authenticated with bearer API keys that can be scoped by role, for example for AI tools. Git Sync manages workspace resources programmatically, and syncs can be configured via API and run on schedules or triggers, so the core headless-automation story is covered. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD integration guide (e.g. triggering syncs from a pipeline), an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
